messages:
Jordan: Anyone doing something wild this weekend? Torn between taking the ferry out to the kite festival on Saturday (sun + wind = perfect) or staying in to finally build the IKEA bookshelf that’s been mocking me for 3 weeks. Votes? :kite: :sweat_smile:
Priya: Kite festival sounds way more fun. Also photo opps. :camera_with_flash:
Samir: I will back the bookshelf brigade. My last IKEA victory ended in 3 missing screws and a YouTube tutorial. :grimacing:
Alex: If you go kite-ing, bring snacks. If you build shelves, also bring snacks. I’m just here for food either way. :chipmunk:
Maya: Haha same. I can help with the bookshelf if you promise no leftover Allen keys in the cushions. I’m free Saturday morning.
Jordan: @Maya sold! If it’s a bookshelf party we’ll do coffee + wrench-sharing around 10am. If kite, meet at ferry terminal 11:15am. I’ll post final plan by 7pm tonight.
Priya: Quick poll: kite = :one:, bookshelf = :two:. Reply with 1 or 2.
Samir: 2
Alex: 1 (but only because I want to see the kites shaped like T-Rex)
Maya: 2
Jordan: 1
calendar-bot: Reminder set by Jordan: "Weekend plans poll" — Event draft created for Saturday 11:15 ferry (if majority picks kite).
Jordan: Looks like a tie but more people voted for bookshelf? Counting: kite 2, bookshelf 3. Bookshelf it is. I’ll bring an extra drill and snacks. Coffee on me. :coffee:
Priya: I can bring bolts and moral support. Also plant-based brownies.
Alex: Alas, I am team kite but I’ll be at a birthday party. Good luck with the Allen key war. Send pics of the finished shelf!
Samir: I’ll bring the spirit level and promise not to lose screws this time.
Maya: See you Saturday 10am at Jordan’s place. Agenda: assemble, level, snack, high-five.
Jordan: Perfect. If anyone changes plans, ping here. Also if any boxes have secret missing parts, we have a standing policy: swear once, then improvise. :crossed_fingers:
